title: China Price Check: $300 Up a Swiss Peak, $49 Up Huangshan | China Travel Expert
description:
Switzerland's most famous mountain ride costs about US$300. Huangshan's? About US$49.

Jungfraujoch — the “Top of Europe” at 3,454 m — is a round-trip train ticket of roughly CHF 261 in peak season, about US$300. China's Huangshan (the Yellow Mountains) gets you to the same sea-of-clouds summit for about US$49 all in: roughly ¥190 scenic-area entry plus a ¥160 round-trip cable car. Not every China Price Check ends with China cheaper — but this one isn't close.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book Huangshan's Yungu or Yuping cable car online before you go — by late morning the queues can top an hour, especially in autumn.

瑞士最有名的雪山列车约300美元，黄山上的云海之巅只要约49美元。
